market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Hot CPI + Fed hike expectations + diesel spike + AI narrative cooling create headwinds. Expect 3-5% equity volatility. Energy outperforms; consumer and rate-sensitive sectors lag. 10Y yield may test 5.0%.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI cloud/security demand structural; Alphabet $514B backlog validates secular trend. Energy transition (BYD solid-state, LNG) creates 12-month opportunities. Consumer weakness likely moderates as rates stabilize. Geopolitical risks remain elevated but manageable.
